issues.title: Nunc scio vere: photographs of the lost tablature (IMuzUJ 014–017)
issues.body:
The edition rests on Perz's 1966 reconstruction and the tablature readings his commentary records. The tablature itself (c. 1590) was destroyed in 1944.

Glass-plate photographs survive: Kraków, Biblioteka i Fonoteka Instytutu Muzykologii UJ, IMuzUJ 014–017 (prints at F.IV 11). They are the only primary witness.

**For the second edition**
- [ ] Obtain images
- [ ] Check every reading of P against them
- [ ] Recheck the four places where T was restored against P (bars 6, 9, 30, 81–83)

issues.title: Nunc scio vere: earliest transcriptions of the tablature (Gołos 1968, 1995)
issues.body:
Gołos (ed.), *The Organ Tablature of Warsaw Musical Society* (Graz–Warsaw 1968), pp. 234–237, is probably the earliest transcription, made before or independently of Perz. Gołos, *Tabulatura Łowicka* (Warsaw 1995), pp. 39–40, discusses the Castle fragment.

- [ ] Collate Gołos 1968 against P

issues.title: Już się zmierzka: collate the tune in Seklucjan 1559
issues.body:
The print (A) is lost; the edition rests on Przyborowska's redrawn facsimile (F, 1880). Seklucjan's *Pieśni chrześcijańskie dawniejsze i nowe* (Königsberg 1559), p. 115, prints the tune alone. It is the only other musical witness.

- [ ] Collate S (Kalisz ed. 2007 or the HPAC 1 facsimile, 2012)
- [ ] Check whether S settles the tune-authorship question

issues.title: Vox in Rama: Cantus and organ partbooks (MMP D/11, D/15)
issues.body:
Only the Tenor primi chori of no. 36 has been read in the 1611 print (MMP D/12). Cantus, Altus and Bassus come from modern editions whose common parent is unknown.

- [ ] MMP D/11, *Cantus primi chori* (1983): the Cantus of no. 36
- [ ] MMP D/15, *Partitura pro organo* (1986): the only surviving source for Altus and Bassus. Check: the e♭′ of bar 15, the Altus octave at bars 17–18 (emended), whether the organ part is printed transposed, and whether it doubles the final at the octave
- [ ] MMP D/13, *Altus secundi chori*: confirm no. 36 is not in it

issues.body:

issues.title: Decisions before the resets
issues.body:
Decided 3 Oct 2026; see `docs/editorial-principles.md` §15.

- [x] Strophic songs: as many stanzas as the music needs (rule 10.14)
- [x] Longs: print the source's long at finals and section ends, no added fermata (rule 5.7)
- [x] Nunc scio vere: keep the supplied cut-C, marked editorial (rule 5.4)
- [x] Voice: 'I' for judgements, impersonal for method
- [x] Performance pitch for low-clef pieces (rule 2.2)

issues.title: Apply the pronunciation guide in the resets
issues.body:
The first editions disagree with each other and with the guide:

- [ ] Vox in Rama says 's always voiceless'; the guide has [z] between vowels
- [ ] Nunc scio vere writes ti- as [tsj] and principio as [prinˈtsipjɔ], merging syllables the underlay keeps apart; the guide has [tsi] with a syllabic i
- [ ] Nunc scio vere claims its table is 'as Wacław's singers spoke it' but cites modern school grammars
- [ ] Bogurodzica: note that y in *Kyrie* is [i]; final *modlitwę* [ɛ̃] vs [ɛ]

Each edition keeps only text-specific notes and points to `guides/pronunciation`.
